name: Neutral ground, all chroma in the accent
name_bn: নিরপেক্ষ ভূমি, রং শুধু বিশেষ রঙে
premise: Tests whether the brand's own stated restraint -- a field of empty space, one point of colour, everything aligned to a strong edge -- reads better with NO chromatic field at all. The ground becomes a warm near-neutral (stone); every surface token sits under a stated low chroma ceiling; all colour is spent on one signature plus the two functional hues. Also fixes a real structural weakness in the shipping kit: Meridian currently does double duty as BOTH the page ground and the information colour, so --gru-info and the page background are literally the same family.

ground.label: Stone
ground.note: A warm near-neutral, chroma-capped low so it reads as paper, not as a colour.

accent_light.label: Signal (light)
accent_light.note: The one place chroma is spent freely. A warm red-orange, distinct from the functional danger hue.

accent_dark.label: Signal (dark)
accent_dark.note: Same hue as accent_light, tuned pale for the dark theme -- the one-hue-two-values structure carried over from the incumbent, on a neutral rather than chromatic ground.

support.label: Slate
support.note: A distinct, separate family from the information role -- fixes Meridian's double duty in the shipping kit.
